additional_info.subject: ID0476595-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / N4 160339049] AC Cable Not Working CRM:03431000029
additional_info.body:
Dear Basil ,
I hope this email finds you well.
We have analyzed the timestamps provided to investigate why the charging sessions are dropping. After reviewing the logs, we can confirm that the charger is operating correctly and no internal faults were detected.
Regarding the ticket description, please note that this charger is not equipped with an integrated AC cable; instead, it features an AC socket.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
